newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico peso closes mixed after relaxed session.
newsitem.headline: Mexico peso closes mixed after relaxed session.

text.p: The Mexican peso closed mixed on Friday after a session marked by calm as traders shunned potential jitters ahead of this weekend's local elections and the forthcoming U.S. Federal Open Market Committee meeting.
"The fact is that dealers couldn't care less about town hall elections. Besides, things look like going ahead without a hitch," said a trader.
The benchmark 48-hour peso closed 1.1 centavos firmer at 7.9060/7.9120 per dollar, while its 24-hour stablemate closed 0.5 centavos softer at 7.8950/7.9050.
